name: Call of Earth
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller sets novice Horde shamans a test of endurance and patience. They hunt felstalkers to prepare a ritual sapta.

sections.title: The First Bond
sections.body: A shaman begins by learning to bond with each element. For orcs and trolls, that path starts with earth, the bedrock of life, endurance, and patience. In the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller guides new shamans and teaches them that earth demands respect and steadfastness before it grants protection.

sections.title: A Cleansing Hunt
sections.body: The Burning Blade cult festers in ravines north of the Valley of Trials. Its dark magic summons felstalkers, corrupt hounds from beyond this plane. Hunting them tests whether a shaman can defend the land from unnatural decay. Canaga uses their hooves to brew an Earth Sapta, a sacred draft that opens mortal eyes to the elemental plane.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this trial?
aliases: what does call of earth give
faq.answer: The trial begins a shaman's study of elemental mysteries and tests patience and spiritual discipline before the earth spirits, preparing them to commune with those spirits and earn an Earth Totem.
Canaga Earthcaller is a troll shaman trainer in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He guides young orc, troll, and visiting tauren shamans toward elemental mastery.

faq.q: Why does Canaga need felstalker hooves?
faq.answer: Canaga uses felstalker hooves to prepare an Earth Sapta, a potion that lets a mortal shaman perceive and speak with elemental spirits.
Felstalkers haunt the cave and surrounding bluffs north of the training grounds in the Valley of Trials, within the Burning Blade Coven.

faq.q: Can other Horde races undertake this version of the trial?
faq.answer: Yes. The trial is mainly for orc and troll shamans coming of age in Durotar, but tauren shamans traveling from Red Cloud Mesa can also undertake it in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: What virtues does the earth represent to a shaman?
faq.answer: In shamanic tradition, earth is the foundation of life. It embodies great strength, stamina, and eternal patience, yet can be stubbornly fickle when it is not respected.

angles.text: As a shaman, you begin formal communion with the elements here, laying the foundation for your Earth Totem.
As an orc under Thrall's Horde, returning to the shamanic path honors ancient clan traditions from before the demonic corruption.
As a troll, you follow Darkspear witch doctors and spiritualists in embracing earth spirits to support your people's new home alongside the orcs.
